messages:
maria: Starting rollout for v2.3.1 now. Plan: US-canary 5% -> US-100% -> EU-canary 5% (pin fallback to 2.2.9) -> EU-100% -> APAC-canary 3% -> APAC-100%. Change windows: US 23:00-03:00 PST (07:00-11:00 UTC), EU 01:00-05:00 UTC, APAC 20:00-00:00 UTC. Ops please confirm capacity & warm pool.

deploy-bot: [deploy started] us-canary target=5% model=v2.3.1
```
rolling update: us-canary
instances warmed: 12/12
approx qps capacity: 2200 -> safe
health checks: 24/24 OK
traffic split: 5% canary -> 95% stable
```

kevin: Do we have spare GPUs in us-west for burst? we rely on burst pool for spikes.

anna_sre: us-west warm pool is at 18/20 reserved; can bump to 20 but need approval for extra budget. thermal headroom ok. :thumbsup: 

jia_oncall: EU warm pool is low (6/12). Suggest we pre-warm +4 instances before EU canary. pinging infra for warmup.

deploy-bot: scheduled warmup eu: +4 instances requested
```
warmup job id: w-202331
expected ready in 180s
current eu warm: 10/12
```

samir: Rollback criteria: >3% error increase over baseline for 5m OR latency p50 >300ms sustained 3m. If triggered, pin EU back to 2.2.9: `redwoodctl pin --region eu --version 2.2.9 --reason 'canary regress'`

maria: Adding release note: 'v2.3.1 fixes kv cache eviction bug and improves batching heuristics; minor perf tuning.' Will attach to release later.

kevin: Also flagging model quantization change — watch embeddings quality drift tests for EU.

anna_sre: EU warmup done. capacity now 12/12. We have a 10% cushion for burst during first hour.

deploy-bot: EU-canary started -> 5% traffic
health checks: 12/12 OK
metrics: errors 0.12% (baseline 0.09%), p50 110ms, p95 320ms

jia_oncall: p95 spike 320ms but within rollback threshold? samir?

samir: p95 320ms > 300ms threshold — we only act if sustained 3m. monitor for 3m, if persists we'll pin. For now hold.

maria: ok hold, keep watch. If stable for 10m then proceed EU-100% then APAC warmup. tagging @kevin for embedding tests.

kevin: running embedding eval: started job id emb-443
expect results in 8m.

deploy-bot: Note: EU pinned fallback available: 2.2.9.rollback image ready.

maria: thanks everyone. will post update in 10m. :white_check_mark:
